content:
The partitions of 5 give the products:

\[
55555,\quad 5555\cdot5,\quad 555\cdot55,\quad 555\cdot5\cdot5,\quad 55\cdot55\cdot5,\quad 55\cdot5^4,\quad 5^5
\]

These are:

\[
55555,\ 27775,\ 30525,\ 13875,\ 15125,\ 34375,\ 3125
\]

All are distinct, so there are 7 different numbers.

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
